scientific_stage: M2-B2 graph diagnostic for independently discovered and locally confirmed remote public-I1-compatible surrogates
purpose: Test whether the remote compatible surrogate solutions discovered by non-adaptive M2-A2 and confirmed by M2-A3 produce graph-level sigma predictions that differ from the frozen M1 combination.

variant_design.baseline: BASE_M1 uses the frozen M1 anchor for ProviderA, ProviderB, and ProviderC.
variant_design.alternatives: Create one variant for every M2-A3-confirmed remote candidate by substituting only its provider while holding all other providers at their M1 anchors.
variant_design.rationale: This isolates whether newly discovered remote inverse solutions transmit to graph sigma before any joint/factorial ambiguity experiment.

graph_simulation.seed_bank_relation: Independent of Phase-3 M1 graph seeds 25000..25099 and M2-B TPE-candidate graph seeds 26000..26099.

graph_query.A_G_construction: Use the same frozen public I1 A_i(rho_G) boundaries and corrected frozen M0 deterministic G0 adapter for every variant.
graph_query.comparison_reference: BASE_M1 on the same 27000..27099 graph seed bank

next_gate: After all graph predictions are materialized, first inspect spread vs BASE_M1. Only then may the already-frozen graph white-box reference be opened for evaluation of whether any remote variant improves predictive accuracy.
